CODE
2.3.15. 
Concealment
A spouse who, in bad faith, conceals information or makes false declarations concerning the composition or extent of the community, the undivided interests existing between the spouses or, in the case of a regime of separation of property with a participation clause, the mass of participation, in order to obtain an advantage for himself or herself to the detriment of the other spouse, is guilty of receiving stolen goods.
A spouse who is guilty of receiving stolen goods is deprived of his or her share in the property or assets stolen or, where applicable, is penalised to the extent of the property or assets stolen when calculating the participation claim.
This penalty may not be invoked against a spouse who spontaneously and in good time provides accurate and complete information or rectifies false declarations.
